remarks: Glenbrook Hamilton Green Opportunity! Handy Stamford located near Darien border with easy access to Post Road, I-95 & Metro North RR stations, public bus system. Near beaches, schools, shopping, restaurants, parks, and entertainment that makes Stamford a wonderful place to live and work! Generous living space with ample storage to make your own! Hardwood floors. Newer AC Units. Deck, rear stairs off bright open Living Room, Dining Room, and Kitchen. Two Bedrooms, well-located Bath. Additional private storage and well-equipped card-operated laundry in common basement. Reserved Parking space right in front of Entry. Additional Off-Street Visitor Parking. Enjoy Fall and the Holidays from your special new home!
